title: Gold Bar – Mennica Polska – 1 g
descriptionPlain: Description A 1g gold bar is sold in special packaging that guarantees its authenticity – CertiCard. The packaging includes the bar’s specifications – weight, gold content, and a unique serial number. The design of the bar features the modern logo of Mennica Polska [Mint of Poland], as well as the bar’s weight and gold fineness.
